## Checklist

- [ ] New user-facing text has both voices: `tx(chill, classic)`
- [ ] Tappable elements have an accessibility role / label
- [ ] No health data is logged, sent over the network or stored outside the encrypted database
- [ ] Schema changes come with a migration and a database test
- [ ] Prediction changes include `npm run backtest` output
- [ ] Safety thresholds or wording changes update `docs/CLINICAL_REVIEW.md`
